description:
Implement a video player in the VideoPlayerApp that plays the video file located at 'app/src/main/res/raw/promo_video.mp4' using the Jetpack Media3 ExoPlayer library.

1. Add the necessary dependencies (media3-exoplayer and media3-ui) to 'app/build.gradle.kts'.
2. Update 'activity_main.xml' to replace the TextView with a 'androidx.media3.ui.PlayerView' that fills the screen.
3. In 'MainActivity.kt', initialize the ExoPlayer, bind it to the view, and play the local raw video resource.
4. Ensure the player is properly released in the Activity's lifecycle (e.g., in onStop or onDestroy) to prevent memory leaks.
